proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_regime + by_signal_type×regime×sector = Choppy regime (100%) + UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell (27.27%) (100.0%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + by_signal_type×regime×sector = Choppy regime (100%) + UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell (27.27%); recommended action: Pause new entries in regime=Choppy and specifically block additions to UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank until Bank cell share drops below 0.20 via natural Day-6 exits. Consider a Bank Nifty put or index hedge to offset the 3 Bank longs while regime remains untested at high cohort tier.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If Choppy regime flips to Bear or a sharp risk-off shock hits, all 11 positions are directional-long in the same regime with 4 in Bank sector — coordinated drawdown with no offsetting exposure. Bank-cluster gap risk is elevated given the 27% cell share, and the Candidate-tier cohort provides no historical validation that UP_TRI edge holds through the transition.

evidence: UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell at 3/11 = 27.27%, breaches 0.20 hard cell threshold
UP_TRI×Choppy×Pharma cell at 2/11 = 18.18%, just below cell threshold
Matched Choppy×UP_TRI cohort is Candidate tier (n=339) — unvalidated edge
No offsetting short/hedge exposure in book
risks: Recommendation may be over-cautious; concentration may be edge-validated
Trader may already be aware; informational only

proposals.reversibility: Informational warning; no system mutation. Suppresses on next run if concentration drops below threshold.

decision_metadata.llm_rationale: Regime concentration is triggered at 100% Choppy (11/11, well above the 0.80 threshold), and the book is 100% directional-long (UP_TRI 8/11 = 72.7% + BULL_PROXY 3/11 = 27.3%) — effectively a monoculture. The UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell breaches the 0.20 cell threshold at 27.27% (3/11), and both concentrated cells match only the Candidate-tier Choppy×UP_TRI cohort (n=339) — unvalidated edge. Extends a multi-week warn streak of regime + directional-long monoculture on an unvalidated cohort.
